_doc: The Touch as light and weather (LIVING §0.1.7, §3.6, hooks H2/H7; render/hand.ts, gen/handgen.ts): idle (a whirl of wind, light and cloud), holding (the mantle gathered into a cradle round what it holds, wind bound round it), throwing (the cradle opening, the person it held hurled through the air, streaked in its light), each trusted (warm daylight) and feared (storm-dark, crackling). Lookdev world; F.fx.hand.hold pins the Touch's clock (nextCrackle finds a moment an arc has just struck). Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/touch-living.json --port=5195

shots.name: tl-idle-trusted
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true; F.fx.hand.hold = null; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 0, regard: 0.85, pose: 'open', held: null }); await G.step(1);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 95, tilt: 74, yaw: 20, fov: 55, hour: 15.5 }); F.fx.hand.regard = 0.85; await G.frames(3);
return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, L: +F.fx.hand.scale.toFixed(1), regard: +F.fx.hand.regard.toFixed(2), grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2) };

shots.name: tl-lift-trusted
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 8, regard: 0.85, pose: 'open', held: null }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', kind: 'rock', mass: 2600 }); await G.step(1);
F.fx.hand.hold = 500; await G.frames(2); F.fx.hand.hold = null; await G.frames(2);
return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2), held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId] };

shots.name: tl-close-hold
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm'); F.fx.hand.hold = null;

await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 8, regard: 0.85, pose: 'open', held: null }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', kind: 'rock', mass: 2600 }); F.fx.hand.regard = 0.85; await G.step(1);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 40, tilt: 80, yaw: 20, fov: 55, hour: 15.5 }); F.fx.hand.hold = 520; await G.frames(2); F.fx.hand.hold = null; await G.frames(2);
return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, L: +F.fx.hand.scale.toFixed(1), grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2) };

shots.name: tl-lift-feared
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 8, regard: -0.9, pose: 'grab' }); F.fx.hand.regard = -0.9; await G.step(1);
const t = F.fx.hand.nextCrackle(600, -0.9); F.fx.hand.hold = t; await G.frames(3);
return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, t, crackling: F.fx.hand.crackling, grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2) };

shots.name: tl-villager-trusted
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.hold = null; const p = G.poi('town'); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 0, regard: 0.7, pose: 'open', held: null }); F.fx.hand.regard = 0.7;
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (16 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 3, yaw: 0, pitch: 8, fov: 60, hour: 16 }); await G.frames(1);

const a = G.agents(40).filter((x) => x.dist < 70).map((x) => x.id); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', target: { kind: 'agent', id: a[0] } }); await G.step(1); F.fx.hand.hold = 800; await G.frames(2); F.fx.hand.hold = null; await G.frames(2);

return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], L: +F.fx.hand.scale.toFixed(1), grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2), d: Math.round(F.fx.hand.grip.distanceTo(F.fx.vis.camBody)) };

shots.name: tl-villager-feared
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', regard: -0.85 }); F.fx.hand.regard = -0.85; await G.step(1);
const t = F.fx.hand.nextCrackle(900, -0.85); F.fx.hand.hold = t; await G.frames(3);
return { b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], crackling: F.fx.hand.crackling };

shots.name: tl-throw
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true; F.fx.hand.hold = null; const p = G.poi('town');

if (F.fx.hand.heldKind !== 'agent') { await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 0, regard: 0.7, pose: 'open', held: null }); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (16 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 3, yaw: 0, pitch: 8, fov: 60, hour: 16 }); await G.frames(1); const a = G.agents(40).filter((x) => x.dist < 70).map((x) => x.id); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', target: { kind: 'agent', id: a[0] } }); await G.step(1); F.fx.hand.hold = 800; await G.frames(1); F.fx.hand.hold = null; }
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', regard: 0.7 }); F.fx.hand.regard = 0.7; await G.step(1); await G.frames(1);
const who = F.fx.hand.heldId; const u = F.fx.hand.grip.clone().normalize(); const el = Math.hypot(u.x, u.z) || 1; const E = [u.z / el, 0, -u.x / el];
const r = await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.throw', vel: [E[0] * 12 + u.x * 9, E[1] * 12 + u.y * 9, E[2] * 12 + u.z * 9] }); await G.step(1); await G.frames(1);
const nf = () => { let n = 0; F.fx.m.flights.forEach(() => n++, F.fx.clock); return n; }; for (let i = 0; i < 8 && !nf(); i++) await G.frames(1); F.advance(0.42); await G.frames(2);

let fl = []; F.fx.m.flights.forEach((id, kind, q, v, age) => fl.push({ id, kind, age: +age.toFixed(2), d: Math.round(q.distanceTo(F.fx.vis.camBody)) }), F.fx.clock); return { r: r.msg, who, pins: [...F.fx.m.flights.agentPins.keys()], fl, grasp: +F.fx.hand.grasp.toFixed(2), b: F.fx.hand.behaviour, streak: F.fx.m.throws.group.visible };

shots.name: tl-orbit
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.hold = null; const p = G.poi('farm'); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 0, regard: 0.7, pose: 'open', held: null });
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 2600, tilt: 30, yaw: 0, fov: 50, hour: 14 }); await G.frames(3);
return { L: +F.fx.hand.scale.toFixed(1), vis: F.fx.hand.visible };
